ticket.subject: Feature request: dark theme
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

Writing on behalf of Hollowfen Media. It would be great to have a dark mode in the web app.

The mobile app already has one, so the web app feels inconsistent. Several people on our team have asked for it.

Let us know if it is planned.

Best,
Jonas
